name: Eye for an Eye
source:
You play as Bianca, a student who's just kind of a loner but tries to help everyone she can despite that. After a late shift at your part-time job, you've been kidnapped by a student from the same school as you, the strange, rich loner girl, Noel, for the following reason:

"I need to take your eyes."

Can you, in the very short time you're given, convince her not... to do that?

[From [url=https://lasikortti.itch.io/eye-for-an-eye]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演比安卡，一个有点孤独的学生，但尽管如此，她还是尽力帮助每一个人。打工上晚班后，你被同校学生——奇怪的独来独往的富家女诺埃尔绑架了，原因如下：

“我需要夺走你的眼睛。”

你能在很短的时间内说服她不要……那样做吗？

[来自[url=https://lasikortti.itch.io/eye-for-an-eye]itch.io[/url]]
